dataset_metadata.purpose: Template for collecting real gameplay sessions with observed playstyle labels.
privacy_notes: Do not include names, emails, chat text, or other direct identifiers.
Store consent records separately from the public validation artifact.

labeling_protocol.primary_label_policy: Use majority vote over annotations[].primary_playstyle when labels.primary_playstyle is absent.

claim_boundary: This validates observable playstyle category scoring. It does not validate claims about inferring a user's true personality.

planner.description: Preparation actions before the first build action.
planner.minimum_signal: At least one preparation action and one build action.

iterative_refiner.description: Frequent placement revisions at the same location.
iterative_refiner.minimum_signal: At least one block_place followed by a matching block_break.

route_optimizer.description: Efficient movement path across multiple movement events.

complex_builder.description: High spatial spread and vertical variation in build events.
complex_builder.minimum_signal: At least two block_place events with positions.

resource_diversifier.description: Broad variety of inventory and block resources.

risk_taker.description: Actions in low-height or low-light positions.
risk_taker.minimum_signal: Positioned actions with y < 40 or light_level < 7.
